en_title: League of Legends Virtual K-Pop Group K/DA Reemerge After 6 Years of Silence With New Single and Music Video From the Makers of Arcane
cn_title: 《英雄联盟》沉寂六年，K/DA携新单曲回归
subtitle: 再燃舞台
opus_summary: 《英雄联盟》虚拟女团K/DA携新单曲回归，MV由Fortiche制作，上线九小时播放量突破430万。新EP定于10月21日推出，距上一张已过去六年。

paragraphs.en: After six years of silence, Riot Games' League of Legends-themed virtual K-pop girl group, K/DA, has returned with Firestarter, a comeback single created by the animation studio behind Arcane.
paragraphs.cn: 沉寂六年后，拳头游戏旗下以《英雄联盟》为主题的虚拟K-pop女团K/DA携新单曲《Firestarter》回归，参与制作的是《英雄联盟：双城之战》背后的动画工作室。

paragraphs.en: The single leads K/DA's new EP, set to come out on October 21, which would mark the group's second major release since All Out in 2020.
paragraphs.cn: 这首歌是K/DA新EP的先行单曲。新EP定于10月21日推出，将成为组合继2020年《All Out》之后的第二张主要作品。

paragraphs.en: Returning to the lineup are MIYEON and SOYEON of i-dle, alongside Sophie Powers and Mimi Webb who bring new voices to K/DA’s latest era. The group has previously featured artists including Madison Beer and Jaira Burns, while Seraphine, who joined the virtual girl group for More in 2020 and was voiced by Lexie Liu, is notably absent from the new release. Behind the track are producers Kill Dave and Sebastien Najand, the composer and producer often regarded as one of the architects of K/DA’s sound, having worked on the group’s music since its inception.
paragraphs.cn: i-dle成员MIYEON和SOYEON回归本次演唱阵容，Sophie Powers与Mimi Webb则为K/DA的新阶段带来了新的声音。此前参与组合演唱的歌手包括Madison Beer和Jaira Burns。值得注意的是，2020年通过《More》加入这支虚拟女团、由刘柏辛献声的萨勒芬妮并未出现在新作中。这首歌的制作人是Kill Dave和Sebastien Najand。后者身兼作曲与制作，自K/DA成立起便参与其音乐创作，常被视为塑造组合音乐风格的核心人物之一。

paragraphs.en: “FIRESTARTER” Music Video is out now // https://t.co/EpvKkgbVYF

Behind Firestarter's music video is Fortiche, the French animation studio whose long-standing partnership with Riot dates back to the original Pop/Stars video in 2018. Since then, the two companies have built a creative partnership that extends well beyond music videos, most notably with Arcane, the acclaimed animated series set in the League of Legends universe. With Fortiche involved, the quality of the animation was never really in doubt — and the studio delivers once again.
paragraphs.cn: 《Firestarter》的MV由法国动画工作室Fortiche制作。它与拳头游戏的长期合作可以追溯到2018年最初的《Pop/Stars》MV。此后，双方的创作合作早已不局限于音乐短片，其中最知名的成果便是备受赞誉、以《英雄联盟》宇宙为背景的动画剧集《英雄联盟：双城之战》。有Fortiche参与，动画质量本就无需太过担心，而这家工作室也再次不负期待。

paragraphs.en: Originally scheduled for release on Tuesday, October 20, Firestarter arrived as a surprise drop one day earlier, reportedly following leaks teasing the group’s return. The result is a spark that has already turned into a wildfire, with the music video surpassing 4.3 million views on YouTube alone in just nine hours.
paragraphs.cn: 《Firestarter》原定于10月20日星期二发布，却提前一天惊喜上线。据报道，在此之前，已有泄露消息暗示组合即将回归。这点火星如今已成燎原之势：短短九小时，MV仅在YouTube的播放量就突破了430万。

paragraphs.en: It’s been a particularly busy year for Riot Games’ musical universe with three new songs released in less than a month. Heartsteel returned with Live My Life, True Damage made a comeback with Know My Name, marking a milestone for Riot’s virtual bands as the first to deliver a League of Legends Worlds anthem.
paragraphs.cn: 今年，拳头游戏的音乐宇宙格外忙碌，不到一个月就发布了三首新歌。Heartsteel携《Live My Life》回归，True Damage则带来了《Know My Name》。True Damage也由此成为首个献唱《英雄联盟》全球总决赛主题曲的拳头游戏虚拟乐团，写下了一个里程碑。

paragraphs.en: Add a collaboration with Pentakill on the orchestral Worlds theme, and K/DA were the last of Riot’s major virtual groups yet to re-enter the spotlight. Teasers released last week made it clear that the wait was almost over, and now the final piece of the musical puzzle is back in place.
paragraphs.cn: 再算上与Pentakill合作的全球总决赛管弦乐主题曲，拳头游戏旗下的主要虚拟组合中，就只剩K/DA尚未重返聚光灯下。上周发布的预告已经明确表示，等待即将结束。如今，这幅音乐拼图的最后一块也归位了。

paragraphs.en: Fortiche’s signature hybrid approach, blending 3D CGI with hand-painted textures and hand-drawn 2D elements, gives Firestarter a visual identity that feels both real and ideal. The meticulous, almost obsessive details and hidden references are exactly what fans have come to expect from the studio. League players will easily recognize in-game abilities woven into the choreography — like Ahri’s charm or ult — yet these nods never feel forced or overwhelming to viewers unfamiliar with the game.
paragraphs.cn: Fortiche以标志性的混合技法，将3D电脑动画、手绘纹理与手绘2D元素融为一体，赋予《Firestarter》既真实又理想化的视觉风格。工作室对细节和彩蛋近乎执着的精雕细琢，正是粉丝一直期待的。《英雄联盟》玩家很容易认出编舞中融入的游戏技能，比如阿狸的魅惑或大招；而对不熟悉游戏的观众来说，这些致敬也不会显得生硬或喧宾夺主。

paragraphs.en: A music video this saturated with color could easily become visually exhausting, but Fortiche knows when to pull back. Brief, single-frame visual disruptions break up the dominant pink and orange palette, while infrared-inspired sections make the characters appear to radiate heat. Reflections shimmer in the oil-slick ground beneath the characters, and particles of light seem to bring the heat straight through the screen. Every frame feels planned, building toward a visual spectacle that reflects years of creative collaboration.
paragraphs.cn: 色彩如此浓烈的MV很容易让人视觉疲劳，但Fortiche知道何时该收敛。短暂的一帧异样画面打破了粉色与橙色主导的色调，以红外成像为灵感的段落则让角色仿佛向外散发着热量。角色脚下如覆着油膜的地面闪烁着倒影，光粒似乎将热度直接传出了屏幕。每一帧都像是精心设计过，共同构成一场视觉奇观，展现出双方多年创作合作的积累。

paragraphs.en: Musically, Firestarter knows exactly how to get under your skin. Built around a catchy rhythm and punchy rap sections, the track constantly plays with contrasts, breaking up its harder-hitting moments with melodic, almost ethereal, pre-choruses that make the chorus hit all the harder when it finally explodes. It is a satisfying build-up that keeps the song moving, balancing fiery attitude with melody and making the hook all the more contagious.
paragraphs.cn: 音乐方面，《Firestarter》很懂得如何让人听进去。歌曲以抓耳的节奏和有力的说唱段落为基础，不断制造反差：在冲击力较强的段落之间，穿插旋律优美、近乎空灵的预副歌，让副歌最终爆发时更具震撼力。这种令人满足的层层铺垫推动着歌曲向前，在火热的态度与旋律之间取得平衡，也让记忆点鲜明的乐句更具感染力。

paragraphs.en: Beyond the animation, great visual composition extends to costumes and choreography. Every look reinforces the members’ personalities, each outfit worthy of high-fashion magazine covers — and it would hardly be surprising to see K/DA gracing those pages again . The choreography, meanwhile, seems inspired by drag ballroom culture, combining sharp poses, commanding gestures and theatrical flair into something utterly mesmerizing. It is bold, precise and unapologetically larger than life, the kind of performance that demands your attention even when everything else is already filling your senses.
paragraphs.cn: 除了动画，出色的视觉设计也体现在服装和编舞上。每套造型都强化了成员的个性，每身服装都足以登上高端时尚杂志封面——如果K/DA再次出现在这些杂志上，也丝毫不会令人意外。与此同时，编舞似乎从变装舞会文化中汲取了灵感，将利落的定格姿势、气势十足的手势与戏剧性的表现力结合起来，令人目不转睛。整场表演大胆、精准，毫不掩饰其超乎现实的张扬；即使其他元素已经填满了你的感官，它依然能牢牢抓住你的注意力。

paragraphs.en: With Firestarter, K/DA reminds us why they became one of the most recognisable virtual acts in pop culture. Riot Games and Fortiche have reunited to deliver a music video packed with visual ambition, while the track itself strikes a balance between fan service and mainstream appeal.
paragraphs.cn: 凭借《Firestarter》，K/DA再次让我们想起，她们为何能成为流行文化中最具辨识度的虚拟组合之一。拳头游戏与Fortiche再度携手，带来了一支视觉野心十足的MV；歌曲本身也在满足粉丝期待与吸引主流听众之间取得了平衡。
